newsitem.title: POLAND: NFI units fall 3.5 pct after tax news.
newsitem.headline: NFI units fall 3.5 pct after tax news.

text.p: Polish NFI units fell 3.5 percent to 138 zlotys, hurt by news the finance ministry would scrap in 1998 the corporate tax exemption NFIs enjoy on gains from selling firms in their portfolios, traders said.
The NFI or National Investment Fund units in Poland's mass privatisation programme fell 2.7 percent on Friday after Thursday's news of the tax policy change.

Traders said Monday's strong selling after price-fixing signalled another fall on Tuesday but that the 12.1-million- zloty turnover compared to Friday's 31.2 million suggested falls might not prove steep.
